steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the car on and use the steering wheel controls to select REMAINING OIL LIFE on the driver information display.
Press and hold the check-mark (select) button for several seconds while oil life is showing.
The display shows 100% OIL LIFE when the reset worked.
oil.note: Checked in the 2016 and 2017 owner's manuals. The 2017 manual also allows pressing the accelerator pedal fully to the floor and releasing it three times within five seconds while oil life is showing.

steps: If the light comes on while driving, stop as soon as it is safe and check the tires.
Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label on the driver's door pillar.
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressure is corrected, then goes off on its own after a short drive.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2011 and 2013 owner's manuals.
